mapper.select:
select t1.* from TBL_CEA_INTERNAL_WEBSITE_APPLY t1 left join TBL_STAFF t2 on t2.STAFFID = t1.CONTACT where 1=1 and (t1.creator = #{param.creator}
or t1.creator in (SELECT DISTINCT STAFFID FROM TBL_USER_ORGRELATION WHERE DEPTID IN (${param.getDeptIds})) )
and t2.REALNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.contactName},'%'))
and t1.infoTitle like concat('%',concat(#{param.infoTitle},'%'))
order by t1.id desc
